composition_subtypes.role: sort agility to enable binary search on max soldiers

payload.core_composition_summary: Binary search over number of soldiers using sorted agility thresholds, combined with greedy interval merging of dangerous traps.
payload.rationale: The solution sorts agility for binary search and sorts traps for greedy interval merging, coordinating both to determine max feasible soldiers.
